from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, RGBColor, Inches

from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.enum.section import WD_ORIENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

def new_doc():
    d = Document()
    st = d.styles["Normal"]
    st.font.name = "Times New Roman"; st.font.size = Pt(11)
    st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Times New Roman")
    pf = st.paragraph_format; pf.space_after = Pt(6); pf.space_before = Pt(0)
    for lvl, sz in [(1, 13), (2, 12), (3, 11)]:
        h = d.styles["Heading %d" % lvl]
        h.font.name = "Times New Roman"; h.font.size = Pt(sz); h.font.bold = True
        h.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x1F, 0x2A, 0x44)
        h.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Times New Roman")
        h.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(12 if lvl == 1 else 8); h.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)
        h.paragraph_format.keep_with_next = True
    sec = d.sections[0]
    sec.left_margin = sec.right_margin = Inches(1); sec.top_margin = sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.9)
    return d

def runs(p, text, size=None, color=None):
    # supports **bold** segments
    parts = text.split("**")
    for i, part in enumerate(parts):
        if not part: continue
        r = p.add_run(part)
        if i % 2 == 1: r.bold = True
        if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
        if color: r.font.color.rgb = color
    return p

def para(d, text, bold=False, italic=False, align=None, size=None, indent=None):
    p = d.add_paragraph()
    runs(p, text, size=size)
    if bold:
        for r in p.runs: r.bold = True
    if italic:
        for r in p.runs: r.italic = True
    if align == "center": p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    if indent: p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(indent)
    return p

def bullet(d, text, level=0, numbered=False):
    style = "List Number" if numbered else ("List Bullet" if level == 0 else "List Bullet 2")
    p = d.add_paragraph(style=style)
    runs(p, text)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
    return p

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd"); shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear"); shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto"); shd.set(qn("w:fill"), hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def table(d, header, rows, widths=None, size=8.5, rating_col=None):
    t = d.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(header))
    t.style = "Table Grid"; t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i, h in enumerate(header):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]; c.text = ""
        runs(c.paragraphs[0], h, size=size); 
        for r in c.paragraphs[0].runs: r.bold = True
        shade(c, "D9E1F2")
    # repeat header row
    trPr = t.rows[0]._tr.get_or_add_trPr(); th = OxmlElement("w:tblHeader"); th.set(qn("w:val"), "true"); trPr.append(th)
    colors = {"RED": "F4CCCC", "AMBER": "FCE5CD", "GREEN": "D9EAD3", "CRITICAL": "EA9999"}
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, v in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text = ""
            lines = str(v).split("\n")
            for j, line in enumerate(lines):
                p = cells[i].paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else cells[i].add_paragraph()
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(1)
                runs(p, line, size=size)
            if rating_col is not None and i == rating_col:
                key = str(v).split()[0].strip("*").upper() if str(v).strip() else ""
                if key in colors: shade(cells[i], colors[key])
    if widths:
        for row in t.rows:
            for i, w in enumerate(widths):
                row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    d.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def footer_pn(d, text):

        p._p.append(fld)
